name: Waypoint
feature_notes: Waypoint organizes the existing Engine into one four-office command area, grouped workspaces and programs, and an Engineering directory with direct station and return controls. Existing vessel routes, authorization, records and TrueFit board measurements are retained. No backend change. See WAYPOINT_GUIDE.md.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Countercraft tables, private storage and exact-vessel gateway verified. TrueFit service v2 deployed; Sea Trial remains enabled only by owner publication.
